_source: **Expected exemption ₹68,000, taxable ₹52,000.** LTA received ₹1,20,000; Bengaluru → Delhi, flown, ₹68,000 for the family. The fare the Rules admit is entered as ₹80,000 so the amount incurred binds (DR 08: "air fare limb — NEEDS VERIFICATION"). "One journey already claimed … within the 2026-2029 block. This is the 2nd": the earlier journey is the ledger's, this one on 10-2-2027 (erratum below DR 08 T5, D-153).
